nativeReloadAdmission20261024.finding: CBE admission did not check active selected-rifle or UGL round/magazine reload states before native reload. LOAD/AIM only checked magazine phase6 and relied on incomplete sampled state. It could replace native weapon work or request fire during round cycling. This is a source admission gap, not reproduced engine interruption.
nativeReloadAdmission20261024.implementation: Local read-only settled-state predicate validates full7field native state, string selections/magazine, finite nonnegative round count and settled magazine phase. Candidate rifle/muzzle and final load admission reject active reloads. LOAD waits within original deadline; AIM rejects changed/busy readiness before the sole native fire request. An exact empty state (no magazine, zero rounds, round phase-1 and magazine phase0) is admitted for loading only, never selection/fire.
nativeReloadAdmission20261024.correctionDuringDevelopment: Official native state contract identifies round phase-1 as removed magazine, not generic busy. Initial stricter implementation passed static build but would refuse that valid empty-load case; corrected before final candidate, existing test extended to cover it. Initial passing log is historical, final candidate is authoritative.
nativeReloadAdmission20261024.authorityAndBalance: Existing idle/target/ROE/group/actor/owner/epoch/native-route/feature/task/care gates, original25sdeadline,60s admission cadence, carried-ammo semantics, one reload/selection/fire request and actual FiredMan evidence unchanged. nativeReloadAdmission20261024.cost: Additional native state reads only within existing opt-in bounded16actor/8muzzle admission and final chosen actor.
